name: Neon Dashboard
description: Dark product-demo shorts: a near-black stage, one lime accent, glass UI cards in the upper two thirds, a flat cartoon presenter bottom right, and captions where the spoken accent word sits in a lime selection box.
rules: One lime accent (#C8F848) for the single most important word or number per beat.
One card in the upper 60 percent; it changes state each beat instead of cutting away.
The presenter changes pose about every 1.2 s.
Captions: the spoken accent word in a lime selection box, other words dim until spoken.
native_moves: a card animating from one state to the next in place
a counter flipping to its final number on the spoken word

structures: claim, three proof cards, one comment prompt
before and after of one workflow
a list that checks itself off line by line
openings: the result number first, then how
a question typed into a terminal
a card dropping into frame with the claim
endings: the counter at its final value

camera_language: Locked frame; motion lives in the cards (state changes, counters, wipes) and a 3 percent push on the card.
typography: select-box captions at 54 px; mono eyebrow above cards.
audio_direction: Steady low bed at -22 dB, soft tick on each card state change, rise before the final number.
pitfalls: Do not fill the stage: keep one card.
Lime only on the key word.
